findings.issue: Lagged features use shift(1) before aggregation, ensuring temporal validity - cnt_lag_1, cnt_roll_7, and cnt_roll_std_7 are computed from t-1 or earlier
findings.why_it_matters: Prevents target leakage by ensuring features at time t only use information available at t or before

findings.issue: feature_columns() filters out all FORBIDDEN columns (casual, registered, cnt, instant, yr, days_since_2011, cnt_2d_bfr) from model input
findings.why_it_matters: Excludes leakage-prone columns including the exact target decomposition (casual + registered == cnt)

findings.issue: temporal_split() splits by date: train=2011, valid=H1 2012, test=H2 2012 - never random
findings.why_it_matters: Temporal splits prevent data leakage across folds and ensure models don't memorize future outcomes

findings.issue: baseline_mean using DummyRegressor and baseline_persistence using PersistenceBaseline class are fitted and reported alongside model scores
findings.why_it_matters: Baselines reveal distribution shift and whether models learn patterns beyond naive prediction

findings.issue: HistGradientBoostingRegressor uses random_state=0; DummyRegressor is deterministic; Ridge has fixed alpha=1.0
findings.why_it_matters: Fixed seeds ensure reproducibility when the pipeline is regenerated from scratch
